description.value:
Frequency once per round

Your cirrisensors regenerate and help you shrug off afflictions. Attempt to counteract an effect of your choice imposing one of these conditions on you: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Blinded], @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Dazzled], @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Deafened], sickened, or stupefied. This counteract check uses your Fortitude modifier against the target's DC, and your counteract rank is equal to half your level rounded up. If you didn't counteract the effect, but you would have if its counteract rank were 2 lower, you instead suppress the effect until the beginning of your next turn. The effect's duration doesn't elapse while it's @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Suppressed] in this way.

This effect can't cure curses, diseases, or other long-term afflictions with these conditions as part of their normal state, but it can temporarily remove the condition. If the underlying affliction isn't treated, any counteracted conditions return after 24 hours.
